bull_bear.body:
- Deck's ratio annexure shows Debt-to-Equity (in X) falling from 0.5 across FY21-FY25 to 0.14 in FY26.
- Networth (Rs. in Mn) stated as 321.6 (FY20), 388.2, 486.9, 569.5, 691.6, 822.8 (FY25) and 1,417.59 (FY26).
- Return on Capital Employed (in %) stated as 20.2, 25.9, 28.9, 21.6, 26.1, 23.5 and 16.10 for FY20-FY26; Return on Equity (%) 13.0, 18.4, 23.2, 15.6, 19.4, 17.3 and 11.40 over the same years.
- Reinvestment is directed at owned capacity (Rs. 50 crore greenfield) and COCO stores first, with franchising and OEM outsourcing used to limit capital intensity; the deck mentions no dividend or buyback policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Deck claims a "Well established brand with PAN India presence": 220 Distributors, presence in 26 States, 20,000+ Retail Touchpoints in India, 1 Brand, 1,844 Employees and 7 EBOs in East India, with the stated ambition to be the "Biggest Kidswear Brand".
- Three-phase self-description: "Establishment phase 2004-2013" (contract manufacturer for other brands, founded in Kolkata, West Bengal), "Well established listed kids apparel brand 2014-2023", and "Vision 2030: going direct to consumer, 2024 & beyond".
- Business model widens by phase: Manufacturing + Retail B2B (20 Distributors, 13 States) → Manufacturing, Retail B2B, E-commerce B2B (170 Distributors, 26 States, 7 Countries exports) → adding Retail D2C and E-commerce D2C (300 Distributors, 300+ EBOs, 12 Countries exports).
- Disney licensing agreement described as a "Strategic Partnership that allows IRIS to design and sell apparel featuring beloved characters from Disney & Marvel universe", plus "FAMA Approval for Manufacturing" of Disney products "opening export opportunities"; deck says the exclusivity gives "Premium Pricing Capability" contributing to "higher profit margins".
- Exports "under Brand" to 9 Countries listed as Portugal, Nepal, Mozambique, Saudi Arabia, Africa, UAE, Middle East, Philippines, Sri Lanka.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Leadership] "Iris Clothings Limited was steered to success by a proficient management team, led by founder and visionary Santosh Ladha"; the deck names no other individual and gives no board or succession detail.
- [Certification] Collaboration with Disney is said to certify "process & stringent quality control", and FAMA approval was received to manufacture Disney products.
- [Industry backdrop] Annexure cites Domestic Textile & Apparel Market ($ Billion) of 106 (2020), 75 (2021), 125 (2022), 160 (2023) and 250 (2030F), and an Indian Apparel Retail Industry Forecast ($ Million) series of 59,980; 64,585; 70,605; 76.647; 82,804; 89,219 against years 2022-2027.
- [Segment mix] Indian Apparel Industry, Category Segmentation shown as 46% / 38% / 16% against Menswear, Womenswear and Kidswear — the deck does not bind each percentage to a named category in the extracted text.
- [Registered office] 103/24/1, Foreshore Road, Howrah 711 102; CIN L18109WB2011PLC166895.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Iris Clothings as a well-established, PAN-India listed kids' apparel brand (DOREME) built on in-house manufacturing in Howrah and a distributor-led B2B network, now pivoting under "Vision 2030" to a direct-to-consumer model of company-owned exclusive brand outlets and online retail.
